title: The board's first-draw full re-request asks for pane focus, which only a person-started toggle should
description:
opum-doc ruling seq 171 (opum-doc#627), relayed by opum-agent in the OPAG-1089 dispatch, 2026-10-02: pass a pane `focus` only on a full toggle the person starts. A full mode that is RESTORED, or RE-REQUESTED on a first draw or a viewport change, opens WITHOUT focus.

Measured in the code rather than inferred: hooks/register.tsx:735 passes `focus: true` from the ui.render re-request that fires once per size for a restored full mode -- the path a first draw or a viewport change takes. `setFull` (hooks/register.tsx:526), which is the toggle a person starts with the `z` key or the command's `full` argument, asks for focus correctly and keeps it. So the defect is one argument on the render path, not the toggle itself.

Found while landing the 0.13.0 ruling set; the board shipped in QCLI-435.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A full mode restored at session start, and the once-per-size re-request the first draw makes for it, open the pane without asking for focus
A full toggle a person starts -- the z key or the command's full argument -- still opens the pane focused
A test pins both halves and fails against the pre-fix hooks module

plan: 2. Drop the focus argument from the ui.render once-per-size re-request (hooks/register.tsx:735); leave the person-started toggle in setFull focused
3. Add a test to tests/board.test.tsx pinning both halves, and confirm it FAILS against the pre-fix module before trusting it
4. Run the mod test suite and the repo check
5. PR into dev, green required checks, squash merge, prune the branch
